_comment: The smallest runnable managed game: no gameplay, just the binding layer running inside the real engine. Doubles as the launcher's minimal sample.
_comment_compileManagedSources: The only game that rebuilds assets/csharp on start; this is the target used while iterating on the bindings themselves.
_comment_project: The one project with no Scripts/ of its own. Its code is GkNext.Game, the engine's binding probe: GkNext.Bootstrap links it by default under NativeAOT and gnb dotnet probe builds it, so it stays with the engine in assets/csharp and this manifest points there.
